# ascii-sky

The renderer and React component are built from [unvalley/ascii-sky at da8fd8a](https://github.com/unvalley/ascii-sky/tree/da8fd8a6a3681e16b902997301a8f038203a1f10). The JavaScript and declarations were generated with TypeScript 5.9.3 using `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --declarationMap false --sourceMap false`.

The original artwork from `assets/` is served from `apps/web/public/ascii-sky/`. Both directories include the upstream MIT license.
